## 4. Popular Pilgrimage & Outstation Circuits from Chennai

### 1. Chennai to Tirupati Balaji Pilgrimage (1 Day / 2 Days)
- Distance: Approx. 150 km one way (300 km round trip).
- Routes Covered: Chennai -> Tiruttani -> Renigunta -> Tirupati -> Alipiri -> Tirumala.
- Features: Assistance with early morning Sheegra Darshan timings, Padmavathi Temple (Tiruchanur), and Sri Kalahasti Rahu-Ketu Kshetra.

### 2. Kumbakonam Navagraha 9-Temple Circuit (2 Days / 3 Days)
- Covered Temples: Suryanar Kovil (Sun), Thingalur (Moon), Vaitheeswaran Kovil (Mars), Thiruvenkadu (Mercury), Alangudi (Jupiter), Kanjanur (Venus), Thirunallar (Saturn), Thirunageswaram (Rahu), Keezhperumpallam (Ketu).
- Route: Chennai -> Tindivanam -> Mayiladuthurai / Kumbakonam.

### 3. Chennai to Pondicherry Weekend Getaway (1 Day / 2 Days)
- Distance: Approx. 160 km via East Coast Road (ECR scenic route).
- Stops: Mahabalipuram shore temple, Covelong beach, Auroville, Promenade beach, French Quarter.

### 4. Southern Temple Corridor (4 to 5 Days)
- Route: Chennai -> Trichy (Srirangam) -> Madurai (Meenakshi Amman) -> Rameswaram (Ramanathaswamy & Dhanushkodi) -> Kanyakumari.

### 5. Hill Station Circuits
- Ooty & Nilgiris: 550 km from Chennai via Salem & Mettupalayam. Hill-trained chauffeurs for Kotagiri and Coonoor ghat roads.
- Kodaikanal: 520 km from Chennai via Dindigul and Batlagundu ghat road.
- Munnar (Kerala): 580 km from Chennai via Theni / Bodimettu ghat road.

## 6. Chennai Airport Taxi & Transfers (MAA)
- Pickup & Drop: Chennai International & Domestic Airport (T1, T2, T4 terminals at Meenambakkam).
- On-Time Guarantee: Chauffeurs arrive 15 minutes ahead of scheduled flight touchdown with customer name placards.
- Zero Surge Rates: Fixed tariffs irrespective of rain or peak-hour congestion.

## 7. Tariff Calculation, Transparency & Billing Rules
1. Per-Kilometer Computation: Starts and ends at the designated dispatch garage (Medavakkam) or agreed pickup location in Chennai. Calibrated vehicle odometer reading verified by passenger at start and completion.
2. Driver Allowance (Batta): Fixed daily fee per calendar day (Midnight to Midnight cycle) covering chauffeur boarding and lodging.
3. Tolls & Parking: Toll plaza charges (FASTag automated electronic tolls) and airport/monument parking tickets are billed at actual government slips with zero markup.
4. Interstate State Entry Permits: When crossing Tamil Nadu borders into Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Pondicherry, or Kerala, government border permit taxes apply at actuals.
